metadata.article_title: When witness to be compelled to answer

article.title: When witness to be compelled to answer
article.content:
150When witness to be compelled to answer

Section 150 · Part IV · Chapter X
If any such question relates to a matter relevant to the suit or proceeding, the provisions of section 137 shall apply thereto.
